title: Refill reminder texts → on-time refills
teaser: Organised patients opt in; a random branch pilot gives a clean nudge.
question: Do refill reminder texts help patients refill on time?
ask: We want the extra on-time refills per 100 patients.

treatment.name: texts_on
treatment.meaning: 1 = signed up for refill reminder texts

outcome.name: refilled_on_time
outcome.meaning: 1 = refilled within 5 days of running out

instrument.name: branch_pilot
instrument.meaning: 1 = patient's branch was randomly picked for the texting pilot (staff offered sign-up at the counter)

hidden.name: U_carer
hidden.label: carers signing up the patients they look after

notes.text: Signing up for texts is optional.
Half of our branches were picked at random for a pilot where staff offered sign-up at the counter.
Many sign-ups are done by carers for the patients they look after, and we don't record who has a carer.

traps.name: Organised patients opt in
traps.text: Opt-in patients were already better at refilling.

traps.name: Random branch pilot
traps.text: The pilot is a natural experiment identifying the effect for patients the pilot moved.

traps.name: Unrecorded carers
traps.text: Carers drive both sign-up and refills; not answerable from this file.
